div.div:
1 Corpora and splits
Ben-Sarc • BanglaSarc • BanglaSarc3
Harmonise to a binary label space
(drop BanglaSarc3 neutral)
Normalised exact-match deduplication
and label-conflict removal
Frozen stratified 80/10/10 splits,
hashed and reused everywhere

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(68, 68, 68), rgb(179, 179, 179));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 239px; height: 1px; padding-top: 136px; margin-left: 476px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 16px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
2 Directed transfer matrix
BanglaBERT trained on each source,
evaluated on all three targets
3 × 3 = 9 directed cells
× 10 matched seeds × 2 systems
Off-diagonal targets filtered against
the whole source corpus
Pre-model shift audit on every pair

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(68, 68, 68), rgb(179, 179, 179));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 239px; height: 1px; padding-top: 95px; margin-left: 789px;

display: inline-block; font-size: 16px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
3 Source-only strategies
Fast-gradient adversarial fine-tuning
Leave-one-corpus-out multi-source
Domain-adversarial source-
generalisation training (GRL)
Source-validation threshold recalibration
Pooled-all reported separately: it sees
target labels and is a known-target
comparator, not a fifth remedy

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(68, 68, 68), rgb(179, 179, 179));

display: inline-block; font-size: 16px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
4 Target-supervised adaptation
Fine-tune each source model on
k labelled target examples
k ∈ {0, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000}
drawn from the target train split only
Six directions × seven budgets
Compared against a target-only control
starting from the pretrained encoder
with a newly initialised head

1 Mean macro-F1 falls from 0.847
in domain to 0.534 across corpora:
a 31.3-point loss at 0.630 retention

2 The corpus scoring 0.980 in domain
is the weakest source, collapsing to

4 A median of 100 labelled target

trained reference in five of six directions
